boundaries: Browser rendering, controls, responsive inspection and browser downloads remain unverified. NativeFloat64 semantic values and signed zero are retained. Raw NaN payload/sign/signalling bits, original decimal lexemes and process-local scalar alias identity remain separate gates.

Native serializer text and the static metric-name C-string are copied as actual returned bytes. Native text may contain invalid UTF-8. Canonical full result storage is separate and no implicit native serializer repairs or normalizes it.

Local diagnostics separate groups replace the by-value options copy according to native semantics, including empty-map fallback. The recorded unchanged options snapshot is the prepared caller value, not the inaccessible mutated native parameter copy.

Two explicit role-to-local workflows exercise six client-derived argument Files and two reports, separately from thirteen authoritative artifact handoffs. Their source bytes, resource vectors, selectors and actual response provenance are retained; no hidden second native algorithm call occurs.
The older shared-workbench table metadata carrier issue remains open. This EventLog-only organizational workflow does not repair the shared table implementation.

The first actual API plan freezer stopped before producing a plan because staged UI binding paths needed normalization. Its failed record is retained; successor freezer2 used unchanged candidate, bridge, reader, collector and preflight proofs. That failure sent no HTTP request and repeated no native build or test.

Preexisting transport/parser limits and native validation/default/unknown-enum/truncation behavior remain visible. Browser, performance, concurrency and every remaining strict reference gate remain separate.
